Definition: to smoke, i.e. turn into fragrance by fire (especially as an act of worship)
BiblicalUsage: v; 1) to sacrifice, burn incense, burn sacrifices, make sacrifices smoke; 1a) (Piel); 1a1) to make sacrifices smoke; 1a2) to sacrifice; 1b) (Pual) to smoke a sacrifice; 1c) (Hiphil); 1c1) to make sacrifices smoke; 1c2) to cause incense to smoke, offer incense; 1c3) to make smoke upon; 1d) (Hophal) to be made to smoke; n m; 2) incense; n f; 3) incense-altar
